scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Zhu Po Long?
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
你打完50只年兽了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
嗯，我觉得你还没打够50只。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Remember, I need help hunting Zhu Po Long so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
记住，我需要你帮忙打年兽，所以去把50只年兽都解决掉。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Please kill 50 Zhu Po Long in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
请击杀50只年兽，好让这里成为人们可以来刷<黑暗搜集者>经验值的地方。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
太棒了，你的速度真快。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
太好了！
你是来帮我的吧？
如果不是，我真不知道该怎么处理这里的魔物了！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Zhu Po Long around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
太好了！我一看到你，就知道可以指望你！
我需要你减少目前在这个地图上肆虐的魔物数量！
年兽太多了，导致低等级玩家无法在这里获得良好的经验值。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
So, would you still like to help me?
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
那么，你还愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Thank you for your great help with the Zhu Po Long!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
非常感谢你帮我处理年兽！
目前情况已经稳定，我不再需要你帮忙击杀它们了。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Kill 50 of those Zhu Po Long and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
去击杀50只年兽，完成后告诉我。我会奖励你的努力。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
如果你改变主意了，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
如果你改变主意了，请回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
天哪，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Zhu Po Long are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[屠龙者]
抱歉，我现在没法说话，我快被这些该死的年兽打死了。
